proposal.title: 100-Coin daily commitment prototype
principles: This hypothetical candidate retains its 10/25/50 expedition table and original pouch values. The installed control follows the current production rates and smaller versioned random pouches.
Reserve new expedition direct Coins, full pouch value and maximum possible positive cosmetic salvage before launch. Establish any reduced direct amount before the child commits; never trim a claim.

Reserve a random activity pouch's full face value before granting it. Only candidates whose full value fits the remaining allocation are eligible before the draw; never grant a partial pouch or reroll saved loot.
Each child's new commitments reset daily without banking unused allowance. Redemptions may exceed 100 Coins on a later day because previously established rewards are paid in full.
Preserve owned pouches, frozen expedition loot and authored challenge promises. Fixed authored rewards stay outside this proposed random-grant allocation and must be reported separately.
Track reserved, paid and outstanding Coin values separately, along with empty item slots, zero-Coin expeditions and permanently unavailable content.

blockers.title: Evaluate the prototype against explicit targets
blockers.detail: The Lab now separately models the 75/25 allocation, fixed expedition rewards and full-value pouch reservations. The income-envelope candidate remains a separate policy that omits payout excess.
blockers.next_action: Save paired 90-day and 365-day comparisons with income, purchasing and content-access targets; record the design decision and affected acquisition paths before implementing live rules.

blockers.title: Preserve every established reward
blockers.detail: The in-memory model pays established rewards fully. Production has no corresponding reservation protocol; existing pouch stacks read shared item definitions rather than a per-unit face-value snapshot.
blockers.next_action: Specify versioned reward definitions and reservation records; test full redemption, late claims, retries, concurrent launches and the accounting of outstanding promises.

blockers.title: Specify Lucky Coin timing
blockers.detail: Live Lucky Coin can double direct expedition Coins at claim. Consumable effects are excluded from both Lab policies, so neither candidate proves a live maximum payout.
blockers.next_action: Decide when boosted value is established and reserved, then simulate and test activation, expiry and delayed claims without changing prior promises.

blockers.title: Check pouch and collection access
blockers.detail: The prototype reports filtered grants and unavailable finite targets because full-value reservations change acquisition paths. Missing paths are not additional playable runway, and source-level availability does not guarantee timely completion.
blockers.next_action: Audit every affected acquisition path, first-reward pacing, empty returns and collection milestones; use the content workbench for new reward versions and a reviewed code change for expedition policy.
